answer_value: W ! R x Y ? O & P
steps: W ! R: W is wife of R; R x Y: R is father of Y, so W is mother of Y
Y ? O: Y is mother of O; O & P: O is brother of P, so Y is mother of P
Hence W is mother's mother of P
